architecture: in-process native plugin (dbghelp.dll proxy loaded by enshrouded_server.exe under Wine/Proton) that hooks the game and holds the Takaro Generic Connector WebSocket itself (WinHTTP, TLS); loopback HTTP 127.0.0.1:18890 serves diagnostics only
runtime: enshrouded_server.exe game build 1024233 (Steam build 23178631) under GE-Proton10-30 in mornedhels/enshrouded-server:1.7.2-proton; native connector (0.6.0 candidate)

statusDefinitions.proven: observed end-to-end via MCP plus game-side check
statusDefinitions.partial: works on one side, not proven end-to-end via MCP
statusDefinitions.pending: not implemented or not tested yet

getPlayer.note: online via player updates; offline: a real IGamePlayer from known-players.json (module command for an offline player succeeded)

getPlayerLocation.note: MCP playerongameserverSearch position + trackingGetPlayerMovementHistory; matches start spawn point within 0.2 m and follows teleports

getPlayerInventory.note: MCP trackingGetPlayerInventoryHistory matches in-game backpack (Ward_T1 level 5, arrows 26, club); Takaro history records changes only, so the unchanged starter legs (equipment) never appear there; plugin returns them

giveItem.note: non-admin player; game ignores count, plugin splits into full-stack + single actions (max 64); Admin-group player: give x5 + x4 arrived in client, a later client-driven backpack move was accepted server-side, no crash. Persistence across restart not verified (server was hard-killed before save and the character rolled back)

listItems.note: 3609 items via syncItems; names are derived from template codes (no localisation ships with the dedicated server) and can differ from in-game names ('Ward (Tier 1)' vs 'Spectral Ward'); a few non-items (abilities) included

listEntities.note: 977 templates via syncEntities; code-derived names; some non-creatures (containers, traps) included

listLocations.note: 1031 locations served by the native connector; Takaro app-api never calls listLocations, so not observable end to end

executeConsoleCommand.note: plugin-defined command set (help, players, say, whisper, location, teleport, tp, inventory, give, item, kick, save-and-shutdown); no settime

sendMessage.note: broadcast and whisper proven on the native connector (2026-09-29). Whisper exclusion of other players is NOT verified: only one player account is available

teleportPlayer.note: Takaro rounds coordinates to integers; game nudges to a free voxel spot

kickPlayer.note: Friends group (0.3.0, 0.4.1, 0.4.2) and Admins group (0.4.2) proven via MCP + client 'The host has kicked you from the session.'. Plugin <=0.4.1 silently did nothing for Admins/canKickBan players: the game's own handler skips them; 0.4.2 lifts that check for the one call. MCP returns {} for success and for plugin errors alike

banPlayer.note: online players only (game rule). Timed bans: the connector records expiresAt and lifts the ban itself at expiry (proven 2026-09-29, lifted 3.7 s after expiry); permanent bans too

unbanPlayer.note: requires the player to have been seen online once (hash cache); re-proven 2026-09-29 on the native connector

listBans.note: timed bans carry reason + expiresAt from the connector's store; permanent bans have no reason (the game stores none)

player-connected.note: real joins (2026-09-29, native); at-least-once delivery can store one duplicate after a reconnect

player-disconnected.note: real leaves, kick, shutdown, and reconciliation on the next boot after a SIGKILL with the player online (2026-09-29, native)

log.note: not a stored/searchable Takaro event; arrival only shown by event-rate-limited records (697530ba, limitedEventType log, droppedCount 231)

player-death.note: fall (position, no killer) and creature death ('Limon was killed by Enemy_Wildbeast_Rat_hook') proven live 2026-09-29; killer is the template code

entity-killed.note: exactly one row per kill; entity is the template code and weapon is empty; props/voxel destructibles are filtered out

command.note: real in-game chat with '@' prefix (utils ping, custom ensproof); '/', '!' also pass through

hook.note: real chat-message, real player-connected (playerOnboarding) and MCP hookTrigger

cronjob.note: MCP cronjobTrigger (message seen in client) and natural scheduled runs 20:05, 20:10

teleports.note: @settp/@tp/@tplist/@deletetp; position change confirmed by plugin, server log, MCP pog and screenshots

playerOnboarding.note: join-time welcome is sent while the client is still loading and was not seen on screen; the same hook run via hookTrigger in game was seen

chatBridge.note: stock chatBridge relays Takaro's own server messages back to Discord (Takaro-core echo); use chatBridgeNoEcho

chatBridgeNoEcho.note: player chat -> Discord post succeeded (HTTP 200), Takaro-sent chat not relayed, and a human Discord post reached game chat (2026-09-29, native)

containerRestartReconnect.note: graceful restart, SIGKILL crash, gameserverShutdown and container recreate: identified again within 24 s each (2026-09-29)

serverRestartOnlineReconcile.note: SIGKILL with the player online -> player-disconnected on the next boot

wsDropReconnect.note: socket killed (ss -K) and a 40 s silent blackhole: dead link detected within 20 s, reconnect without a game restart, chat in between delivered

outageNoLoss.note: 30-minute outage: 275 events kept in the durable outbox and delivered after reconnect, 0 losses

timedBanExpiry.note: connector lifted a timed ban at expiry; across a restart only host-tested

signatureSelfCheckDegrade.note: debug build with corrupted addMessage signature: chatEvents+sendMessage degraded, reachability reason names them, server and connection keep running (2026-09-29)

noHelperProcess.note: the game process owns the Takaro socket; no other process or container
